paper.title_en: Constraints on Supermassive Black Hole Binaries from the Lack of Resolvable Sources in the NANOGrav 15-yr Dataset
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have found evidence of a gravitational wave background (GWB) consistent with a population of supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), but have not yet resolved a continuous wave (CW) from an individual binary. We present the first SMBHB population constraints incorporating PTA upper limits on CWs, based on the NANOGrav 15-year (NG15) data. Using semi-analytic models to generate simulated populations, we calculate each sample's GWB likelihood by free spectral comparison and CW nondetection (nCW) likelihoods by (1) mapping each realization's highest CW signal-to-noise ratio (S/N) to a detection probability and (2) counting the fraction of realizations without a binary close enough that NG15 would have detected it. CW nondetection favors populations in which many lower-mass sources, rather than a few ultramassive ones, dominate the GWB. This information is complementary to that provided by the GWB amplitude, breaking the degeneracy between the masses and number of binaries required to reproduce the observed spectrum. Relative to GWB-only constraints, the joint posteriors favor higher galaxy merger rates, lower $M_\mathrm{BH}$-$M_\mathrm{bulge}$ scatter, shorter binary lifetimes, and steeper small-separation hardening. The most detectable sources in the S/N-weighted joint posterior have chirp masses $\sim 10^{9.6} M_\odot$, luminosity distances $\sim$1300 Mpc, and frequencies $\sim$6 nHz, while the nCW-only constraints favor lower frequencies, coinciding with the NG15 4 nHz candidate. These constraints will tighten if CW nondetection continues.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接面向脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）核心问题，首次在NANOGrav 15年数据中结合连续波（CW）非探测上限约束超大质量双黑洞种群，方法具体且给出可检验的种群参数偏好，对PTA引力波背景起源研究具有明确参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 来自NANOGrav 15年数据中缺乏可分辨源对超大质量双黑洞的约束
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）已经发现了与超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）种群一致的引力波背景（GWB）证据，但尚未分辨出单个双星的连续波（CW）。我们基于NANOGrav 15年（NG15）数据，首次给出了纳入PTA对CW上限的SMBHB种群约束。使用半解析模型生成模拟种群，我们通过自由谱比较计算每个样本的GWB似然，并通过以下方式计算CW非探测（nCW）似然：（1）将每个实现中最高CW信噪比（S/N）映射到探测概率；（2）统计没有双星足够近以致NG15本应探测到的实现比例。CW非探测倾向于许多低质量源而非少数极高质量源主导GWB的种群。这一信息与GWB振幅提供的信息互补，打破了重现观测谱所需双星质量与数量之间的简并。相对于仅GWB约束，联合后验倾向于更高的星系并合率、更低的$M_\mathrm{BH}$-$M_\mathrm{bulge}$散差、更短的双星寿命以及更陡的小间距硬化。在S/N加权联合后验中最可探测的源具有约$10^{9.6} M_\odot$的啁啾质量、约1300 Mpc的光度距离和约6 nHz的频率，而仅nCW约束倾向于更低频率，与NG15 4 nHz候选者一致。如果CW非探测继续，这些约束将会收紧。
